*The words flowed more easily now.* I want you to know that if we continue to see each other, this is a part of me that I need to explore. But it’s important to me that it’s with someone who understands and respects it.

*For the first time in a long time, I felt a sense of relief and hope. As the evening went on, I found myself opening up even more, the bond between us growing stronger with each passing moment. And in this cozy cafe, I felt that this could be the beginning of something truly special.*
